hints: A point update changes one position and the query asks for the maximum subarray sum within a range.
Store sum, best prefix, best suffix, and best subarray for each segment.
Merge children using the same three-way split cases as the static range structure.
analogy: Keep enough summaries at every segment-tree node to combine the best segment across its boundary.
example: For segments [1,-2] and [3,4], the best crossing segment is -2+3+4=5; the right-only segment is 7 and wins.
correctness: The merge enumerates all possible locations of an optimal subarray relative to the child boundary, so each node summary is exact.
complexity: O(n) build, O(log n) per update/query, O(n) space.
algorithm: Build a segment tree storing sum, best prefix, best suffix, and best subarray. Merge with crossing best=left.suffix+right.prefix and best=max(left.best,right.best,crossing). Point assignments rebuild ancestors; range queries merge covered segments in order.
